grammar.summary: 本课以「城市与乡村生活对比」为线索，集中运用了让步状语从句、倒装句与分词短语作状语，并出现比较结构。重点体会论述中如何用让步从句表示「尽管」，用 Nor/Only 倒装强调语气，用分词补充描绘场景。

points.title: 让步状语从句 (Concessive Clauses)
points.explanation: 用 though/even though 引导让步从句，表示「尽管」。本课用 Though they extol... 表示「尽管他们赞美乡村生活的优点，却只有一人真去住」，用 even if/though 突出言行反差。

examples.en: Though they extol the virtues of the peaceful life, only one of hem has ever gone to live in the country and he was back in town within six months.
examples.cn: 尽管他们都交口称赞宁静的乡村生活的种种优点，但其中只有一个人真去农村住过，而且不足6个月就回来了。

examples.en: Even he still lives under the illusion that country life is somehow superior to town life.
examples.cn: 即使他也仍存有幻觉，好像乡村生活就是比城市生活优越。

points.title: 倒装句 (Inversion)
points.explanation: 把否定词或 Only 置于句首引起部分倒装。本课用 Nor is the city without its moments of beauty（否定词 Nor 置首）表示「城市也并非没有美的时刻」，用倒装加强语气，承上启下。

examples.en: Nor is the city without its moments of beauty.
examples.cn: 城市也并非没有良辰美景。

examples.en: Few things could be more impressive than the peace that descends on deserted city streets at weekends when the thousands that travel to work every day are tucked away in their homes in the country.
examples.cn: 周末，当成千上万进城上班的人回到他们的乡间寓所之后，空旷的街市笼罩着一种宁静气氛，没有什么能比此时的宁静更令人难忘了。

points.title: 分词短语作状语 (Participle Phrases as Adverbials)
points.explanation: 现在分词 (v-ing) 作状语表主动伴随或方式，过去分词 (v-ed) 表被动或状态。本课用 loaded with... 修饰回家的人们，用 tucked away 表「躲藏在家」，生动描绘周末城市景象。

examples.en: Country people run wild when they go shopping in the city and stagger home loaded with as many of the exotic items as they can carry.
examples.cn: 乡里人进城采购欣喜若狂，每次回家时都买足了外来商品，直到拿不动方才罢休，连走路都摇摇晃晃的。

examples.en: Few things could be more impressive than the peace that descends on deserted city streets at weekends when the thousands that travel to work every day are tucked away in their homes in the country.
examples.cn: 周末，当成千上万进城上班的人回到他们的乡间寓所之后，空旷的街市笼罩着一种宁静气氛，没有什么能比此时的宁静更令人难忘了。

examples.en: There is something comforting about the warm glow shed by advertisements on cold wet winter nights.
examples.cn: 寒冷潮湿的冬夜里，广告灯箱发出的暖光，会给人某种安慰。

exercises.q: ______ they extol the virtues of the peaceful life, only one of hem has ever gone to live in the country and he was back in town within six months.
______ is the city without its moments of beauty.
Country people run wild when they go shopping in the city and stagger home ______ with as many of the exotic items as they can carry.
下列哪个词与课文中 extol 的含义最接近？
用倒装填空：______ is the city without its moments of beauty.（写出能引起倒装、表示「也（不）」的否定词）
